description: Amend an existing confirmed booking (dates, rooms, or guests). For traveler security, you must provide the bookingId along with the guest email address or last name used during booking.

bookingId.description: The unique booking identifier to amend

email.description: The guest email address used during booking (required for verification).

lastName.description: The guest last name (optional alternative for verification).
